    p_label varchar(20), p_at timestamptz, p_local timestamp, p_code char(2), p_ratio float
) RETURNS text

-- A trigger function, read only through the PL/pgSQL compiler (#272).
CREATE FUNCTION public.fn_touch() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
    NEW.created_at := now();
    RETURN NEW;
END
$$
